Labour Market.description: ONS Labour Market Statistics (LMS), release 15 Sep 2026. One row per series per month (Jan 2015 onward), with the value 3 months earlier, 12 months earlier and in Feb 2020 (pre-pandemic, Dec-Feb 2020 for LFS). LFS series are rolling 3-month averages labelled by their final month. Each series (CDID) has its own unit: never add values across indicators.

Period.description: First day of the final month of the period

Period Label.description: e.g. Apr-Jun 2026 for LFS rolling quarters

Sector.description: Industry sector of a sector vacancy series, without the "Vacancies: " prefix. Empty for every other indicator.

Theme.description: Employment, Unemployment, Inactivity, Pay, Vacancies, Regional

Year.description: Calendar year of the period end

Change on Quarter.description: Value minus the value 3 months earlier, in the series' own unit (percentage points for rates).

Change on Year.description: Value minus the value 12 months earlier, in the series' own unit.

Change on a Year Earlier.description: Value minus the value 12 months earlier in the series' own unit, counting only rows that have a reading a year earlier (unlike Change on Year, which returns the value itself when there is none).

Change vs Pre-Pandemic.description: Value minus the Feb 2020 value (Dec-Feb 2020 for LFS series).

Employment Level (000s).description: People in employment aged 16+, thousands. ONS series MGRZ.

Employment Rate.description: UK employment rate, aged 16-64, %, rolling 3 months. ONS series LF24.

Growth on Year %.description: Percentage growth on a year; use for level series (000s, £).

Implied CPIH Inflation.description: Nominal regular pay growth (KAI9) minus real regular pay growth (A2FA), %: the CPIH inflation rate ONS used to deflate pay, to rounding.

Inactivity Rate.description: UK economic inactivity rate, aged 16-64, %. ONS series LF2S.

Latest Change on Quarter.description: Latest reading minus the reading 3 months earlier, in the series' own unit.

Latest Change on a Year Earlier.description: Latest reading minus the reading 12 months earlier, in the series' own unit.

Latest Change vs Pre-Pandemic.description: Latest reading minus the Feb 2020 reading (Dec-Feb 2020 for LFS series).

Latest Regional Employment Change on a Y.description: Change in a region's 16-64 employment rate on a year earlier, latest release, pp.

Latest Regional Employment Rate.description: 16-64 employment rate of a region or nation in the latest release, %.

Latest Regional Unemployment Change on a.description: Change in a region's unemployment rate on a year earlier, latest release, pp.

Latest Regional Unemployment Change vs P.description: Change in a region's unemployment rate since Dec-Feb 2020, latest release, pp.

Latest Regional Unemployment Rate.description: Unemployment rate of a region or nation in the latest release, %.

Latest Share of Sector Vacancies.description: A sector's share of the seven sectors' vacancies in the latest release.

Latest Value.description: The latest published reading of a series (Period Status = Latest), whatever period is selected. Only meaningful with one series in context.

Long-term Sick (000s).description: Economically inactive because of long-term sickness, aged 16-64, thousands. ONS series LF69.

Pay Award vs Private Sector Pay Growth.description: What-if: a pay award of "Pay Award %" minus private sector regular pay growth (KAJ4), percentage points. Positive means the award beats the going rate.

Private Sector Pay Growth.description: Private sector regular pay growth, 3-month average on a year, %. ONS series KAJ4.

Private Sector Pay Growth Change on Year.description: Private sector regular pay growth (KAJ4) minus its value 12 months earlier, percentage points. Empty where there is no prior year.

Public Sector Pay Growth.description: Public sector regular pay growth, 3-month average on a year, %. ONS series KAJ7.

Real Pay Growth Change on Year.description: Real regular pay growth (A2FA) minus its value 12 months earlier, percentage points. Empty where there is no prior year.

Real Regular Pay Growth.description: Real (CPIH-deflated) regular pay growth, 3-month average on a year, %. ONS series A2FA.

Real Value of Pay Award.description: What-if: a pay award of "Pay Award %" minus implied CPIH inflation (KAI9 - A2FA), percentage points. Positive means the award beats inflation.

Redundancies (000s).description: UK redundancies in the three months to the period, thousands (indicator "Redundancies").

Redundancies Change on Year (000s).description: UK redundancies (000s) minus the value 12 months earlier. Empty where there is no prior year.

Regional Employment Change on Year.description: Change in a region's 16-64 employment rate on a year earlier, percentage points.

Regional Employment Change on a Year Ear.description: Change in a region's 16-64 employment rate on a year earlier, percentage points, counting only rows with a reading a year earlier.

Regional Employment Rate.description: Employment rate aged 16-64 for a region or nation, %. Use with Geography.

Regional Unemployment Change on Year.description: Change in a region's unemployment rate on a year earlier, percentage points.

Regional Unemployment Change on a Year E.description: Change in a region's unemployment rate on a year earlier, percentage points, counting only rows with a reading a year earlier.

Regional Unemployment Change vs Pre-Pand.description: Change in a region's unemployment rate since Dec-Feb 2020, percentage points.

Regional Unemployment Rate.description: ILO unemployment rate for a region or nation, %. Use with Geography.

Regular Pay Growth.description: Nominal regular pay (excl. bonuses) growth, 3-month average on a year, %. ONS series KAI9.

Regular Pay Growth Change on Year.description: Nominal regular pay growth (KAI9) minus its value 12 months earlier, percentage points. Empty where there is no prior year.

Sector Vacancies (000s).description: Vacancies in one industry sector, thousands (indicators "Vacancies: ..."). Use with Indicator; 7 sectors only, not the full SIC breakdown.

Sector Vacancy Change on Year (000s).description: Change in a sector's vacancies on a year earlier, thousands. Use with Indicator. Empty where there is no prior year.

Share of Sector Vacancies.description: A sector's vacancies as a share of the 7 sectors shown (not of all UK vacancies). Use with Indicator and one period.

Unemployed per Vacancy.description: Unemployed people per job vacancy. ONS series JPC5.

Unemployed per Vacancy Change on Year.description: Unemployed people per vacancy (JPC5) minus its value 12 months earlier. Up means a looser market. Empty where there is no prior year.

Unemployed per Vacancy Pre-Pandemic.description: Unemployed people per vacancy (JPC5) in Dec-Feb 2020, before the pandemic. A reference level for the trend.

Unemployment Rate.description: UK ILO unemployment rate, aged 16+, %, rolling 3 months. ONS series MGSX.

Unemployment Rate Change on Year.description: UK unemployment rate (MGSX) minus its value 12 months earlier, percentage points. Empty where there is no reading a year earlier (never the value itself).

Vacancies (000s).description: UK job vacancies, thousands, rolling 3 months. ONS series AP2Y.

Vacancies Change on Year (000s).description: UK vacancies (AP2Y, 000s) minus the value 12 months earlier. Empty where there is no prior year.

Value.description: The reading of one series in one period; only meaningful when a single indicator (Series ID) is in context.

Youth Unemployment Rate.description: Unemployment rate, aged 16-24, %. ONS series MGWY.
